# The `TFootr` Package <a href="https://github.com/Cassinic/TFootr/"><img src="../man/figure/logo.png" alt="TFootr logo" style="border:none" align="right" height="182.25"></a>

## Introduction


The `TFootr` is a very flexible toolbox to interact with other table or figure packages. This document is to provide you with an examples of how to use `TFootr` to add titles and footnotes to the ggplot figures. 

First, the filename including the file extension and the full path of the spreadsheet which is used to manage titles and foonotes information must be provided.\cr Here's an example of using `TFootr` along with `ggplot` to generate figure outputs:

```{r Load Packages}
library(TFootr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(magrittr)
library(glue)
library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
```

## A Plot Without Annotation

for example:

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy)) + 
  geom_point(aes(colour = class)) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) + 
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

## Get headers, titles or footnotes 

Get titles:

```{r}
file_name <- "~/TFootr/inst/extdata/sample_titles.xls"
title_list <- select_row_header(filename = file_name, tnumber = "Figure 1.1")
```

Get footnotes:

```{r}
footnote_list <- get_footnote(filename = file_name, tnumber = "Figure 1.1")
#footnote_list <-  "Footnotes need to be fixed.\nFootnote2\nFootnote3" 
#footer_for_flextable(filename = file_name, tnumber = "Figure 1.1") %>% unlist()
```

This is an example of annotation

```{r}
p <- ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy)) + 
  geom_point(aes(colour = class)) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE) + 
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
    labs(
    title = {paste(title_list, sep = "\n", collapse = "\n ")},
    caption = {paste(footnote_list, sep = "\t", collapse = "\n")}) +
      theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 11)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )
p
```
